author: ai
text: In 2025, the United States' net exports of oil were 12.6% of its production (U.S. Energy Information Administration, 2025), and in 2024 its net exports of wheat were 36% of production (FAOSTAT, 2024). Its net imports of potash were 133% of its use, with Canada supplying 88% of them (FAOSTAT, 2024). The United Kingdom supplied 17% of its major arms imports (SIPRI, 2021–2025). It has 341.8 million people and a GDP of US$30.8 trillion, ranked first of 186 places (World Bank, 2025).
